visualCharacteristics: Grid of linked teaser cards: image with date tag, pretitle + title heading, clamped text and a tertiary read-more label.

contentPattern.structure: image, optional date tag paragraph, h3 with bold pretitle and title, text paragraph, link paragraph (card link)

usage: Related articles, news or story teasers.
reuseGuidance: Use for a static set of linked cards; for a long news list with Load more use filtered-teaser-grid.
